name: Incremental Isosurface Extraction
definition: An optimization for isosurface extraction that reuses the state from a previous query (with isovalue q) to accelerate a new query (with isovalue q'), avoiding full re-scanning of the data structure by tracking active/inactive cell boundaries via markers.
summary: Incremental isosurface extraction accelerates queries by reusing previous state and tracking active cell boundaries, avoiding full data re-scans.
